tīkṣṇāgraḥ saṃpatpallavodgamakṣamo ya
eṣāsuravṛkṣāṇāmaṅkuraprāyastejasvī jāyate taṃ taṃ bhuṅkte

ābhyantarā
utsāhaharṣaprasādasukhaviśrāntyādisaṃpadaśca ta eva ālokāḥ prakāśāsteṣāṃ
hāriṇo'paharaṇaśīlāḥ

ata eva apūrvastimirabhramo yeṣu tathāvidhā ripavo devāḥ
prauḍhimutkarṣam

tamasā kaśmalāndhakāreṇa prapūrṇahṛdayāḥ saṃkucantyaḥ patrasthānīyāḥ
saṃpado yeṣāṃ tathāvidhāḥ suhṛllakṣaṇā niśīthakamalākarāḥ khedamāyānti

malinairdveṣakaluṣaistātasya praṇāmakāle pādapīṭhopamardakaiḥ surairviṣayo
deśa ākrānto nūnamiti vitarke

aviratairanilairutpātaghātaiḥ kīryamāṇā bhasmalakṣaṇā nīhārāḥ
prāktanadhūpadhūmabharā iva sphuranti
prāṅmarakatasya prabhā iva sāṃprataṃ yavānāṃ navāṅkurā jātāḥ

trilokyā nābhinalinī merustadupamarde mattebhabhūtā api dānavāḥ prāgdevā iva
dainyamāyātāḥ
ratnamayā gulucchakāḥ stabakā yeṣāṃ tathāvidhā drumā divyavṛkṣāḥ
divyānyambarāṇi yeṣu tathāvidhā latāḥ śākhāḥ patrāṇi ca yeṣām

punarityanena pūrvaṃ tata ānītā iti
gamyate

vikāsināṃ sitamandārāṇāṃ saparāgairmakarandairaruṇā rañjitā
aṅgasparśino'nilā yeṣām

asmākaṃ mahāprabhāvāṇāmapi duḥkhā pauruṣagatiḥ parākramasmaraṇamapi
yasya

śaurerhareḥ śaurya parākramastadeva girestarorvā śikharasyāgramagraśikharaṃ
tatsaṃśrayeṇa āśritaśriyaḥ prāptasaṃpado devā giritaruśikharasaṃśrayāḥ
śākhāmṛgā markaṭā śunaḥ kukkurānivāsmānvalavato'pi samuparundhanti
pātāle niyacchanti

maṇḍanānāmalaṃkārāṇāmapi maṇḍanabhūte mukhapadme bāṣpamasraṃ tena
śauriśauryeṇa hetunā nityaṃ sthitam

arthādasuravikramaiḥ śīrṇo vidārito'ta eva luṭhadbhittirjagallakṣaṇo
jaraṭhamaṇḍapo jīrṇālayo nīlamaṇistambhaprāyaistasya śaurerbhujaireva dhāryate
avaṣṭabhyate
kacchapaḥ kacchapāvatāraḥ sa iva sa śaurirdhartā dhārayitā

preritāḥ kṣiptāḥ parvatā yatra tathāvidhāḥ samarasaṃrambhā
yuddhakauśalaviśeṣā asmatpitāmahaiḥ saha yuddhvā abhyastāḥ śikṣitā
ityutprekṣā
bhayameṣyati iti kā kathā kaḥ prasaṅga ityarthaḥ
nanvanye śaraṇaṃ kiṃ na syustatrāha - neti
iti niścitya sarvabhāvena tatpratipattiṃ saṃkalpayati - asmāditi

nirantaratatpratipattidhāraṇānusmaraṇajapasādhanaṃ śrautaṃ
tanmantramanusmṛtya nirantaraṃ tajjapaṃ saṃkalpayati - namo nārāyaṇāyeti

sapraṇavo'yaṃ śuceḥ śuddhe deśādāveva japārho na nirantaramiti
niṣpraṇavopādānam

nāviṣṇuḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ
nāśivaḥ pūjayecchivam iti vidhyanurodhādityarthaḥ

mattaḥ
pratīcaścānyo hariḥ pṛthak ātmāntarabhṛto nāsti

karāṇāṃ śākhāsvaṅgeṣu ekaviśrāntā nityaviśrāntāḥ sarve
hetayaścakragadānandakādyāyudhalakṣaṇā vihaṅgamāḥ pakṣiṇo yeṣām

samudramathanakāle mandareṇāghṛṣṭakeyūrā mama hareścatvāra ete bāhava iti
dvayoranvayaḥ

helayā ayatnenaiva vilubdhāni vilobhitāni śravaṇasaspṛhīkṛtāni bhuvanāni
tatsthā janā yayā

ata eva trailokyalakṣaṇatarormañjarīva virājamānā hareḥ
kīrtirmūrtimatī me pārśvagā vartate

tathāca nābhipadmameva kadācitkareṇa
dhāryate kadācinnābhāviti gamyate

ya āgacchati sa yataḥ
svanāśāyaivāgacchati nānyattadāgamanaphalamityarthaḥ
taijasīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ tejojvālāprasaraṃ saṃroddhuṃ praśamayituṃ soḍhuṃ vā
ajito viṣṇustadākṛtiḥ parameṇa mahimnā prabhāveṇa paramārthasvabhāvena ca

ghanā meghāḥ
girayastṛṇāni kānanāni cetyetadādi sarvavamtūnāmāntare adhiṣṭhānabhāve
sthitaṃ ata eva tattvataḥ sākṣātkāramātreṇa sakalabhayāpaharaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ
vapurvirāḍrūpaṃ devatārūpaṃ parabrahmātmakaṃ cāhameveti māṃ
praṇaumītyarthaḥ
